findings.body: `use openhuman_core as oh` removes the internal `openhuman` path segment. The crate's public API does not expose `tools` under the root; the original import `openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` was correct. Without a root re-export this will fail to compile. Either restore the original import or confirm that the crate has been rearranged to expose `tools` at its root.
findings.title: Fix the import path after crate alias changes

value.summary: The change replaces a direct `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh` with `use openhuman_core as oh`, which would break all references to `oh::tools` etc. unless the crate root re-exports everything under the `openhuman` module. The lookups confirm there is no `pub mod openhuman` or `mod openhuman` in the crate's source, so the path `oh::tools::traits` after this change refers to an unexported or non-existent module. This is a compile error, not a security issue, but it makes the pull request unmergeable.
